text: We worked with DK Levy on a renovation at one of our senior living communities in the Atlanta market. It was honestly one of the most seamless processes and we received our permit from both the State and AHJ within 3 weeks which is a record for my organization. My company and I look forward to doing many more projects with DK Levy in the future!
